subject: How to track movement of moving carts placed on Transliner

messages.author: 7d0f4f0ed1778184
messages.subject: How to track movement of moving carts placed on Transliner
parts:
Hi Team,

I am working on a simulation.Description is mentioned below

How do we add simulation for a 50 meter long moving transliner of circle shape (only clockwise movement is possible). Here we have 5 cart placed on Trans-liner.
Transliner carts can stop at 9 stations which are adjacent to your transliner. if one cart (Cart Number -1 ) stops at one station then other carts will  travel till the time they reach just beheind this Cart Number -1. When cart number -1 finishes it work, it will start moving and other carts will also start moving behing it.

I have taken resources 

add_resource("TL_CART-1", 1,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%
add_resource("TL_CART-2", 1,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%
add_resource("TL_CART-3", 1,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%
add_resource("TL_CART-4", 1,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%
add_resource("TL_CART-5", 1,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%

add_resource("STATION-1", 1,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%
add_resource("STATION-2", 2,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%
add_resource("STATION-3", 3,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%
add_resource("STATION-4", 4,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%
add_resource("STATION-5", 5,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%
add_resource("STATION-6", 6,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%
add_resource("STATION-7", 7,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%
add_resource("STATION-8", 8,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%
add_resource("STATION-9", 9,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%

add_resource("STATION-1", 1,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%
add_resource("STATION-2", 2,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%
add_resource("STATION-3", 3,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%
add_resource("STATION-4", 4,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%
add_resource("STATION-5", 5,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%
add_resource("STATION-6", 6,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%
add_resource("STATION-7", 7,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%
add_resource("STATION-8", 8,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%
add_resource("STATION-9", 9,  preemptive=TRUE) %>%

add_generator("ARRIVAL", ar, at(rep(0,100)) %>%

How do I track movement of transliner Carts on transliner and calculate waiting time of carts when one cart is serving for arrival at any station?
Could you please explain how can we implement this using simmer?

> I am working on a simulation.Description is mentioned below
>
> How do we add simulation for a 50 meter long moving transliner of circle
> shape (only clockwise movement is possible). Here we have 5 cart placed on
> Trans-liner.
> Transliner carts can stop at 9 stations which are adjacent to your
> transliner. if one cart (Cart Number -1 ) stops at one station then other
> carts will travel till the time they reach just beheind this Cart Number
> -1. When cart number -1 finishes it work, it will start moving and other
> carts will also start moving behing it.

From your description, I would say that carts are processes
(arrivals), not resources, seizing stations, which should not be
preemptive.

You can't track movement in DES, because movement is continuous.
You'll have to simplify that, unless you are interested in simulating
the physics of the problem, which requires other type of simulator.

Iñaki
